snapshot_root.description: Top-level directory where snapshots are stored. Must be on a filesystem with sufficient space and support for hard links.

verbose.description: Verbosity level: 1=quiet, 2=normal, 3=verbose, 4=debug. Affects output to stdout/stderr.

loglevel.description: Log level when file logging is enabled: 1=error, 2=warning, 3=info.

enable_file_logging.description: If true, write logs to the specified log_file_path (in addition to syslog).

log_file_path.description: Path to the log file when file logging is enabled. Will be appended to (not rotated by rsnapshot).

ssh_port.description: SSH port to use for remote backups (passed to rsync via -e 'ssh -p ...').

rsync_short_args.description: List of short rsync options (e.g., ['-a', '-H']). Applied to every rsync call.

rsync_long_args.description: List of long rsync options (e.g., ['--numeric-ids', '--relative']). Applied to every rsync call.

retention_levels.description: Snapshot retention schedule. Each entry defines a snapshot level name (e.g., 'hourly') and how many snapshots to retain.

name.description: Name of the snapshot level (used as command argument: e.g., `rsnapshot hourly`)

count.description: Number of snapshots to keep at this level.

backups.description: List of backup source→destination mappings. Each maps a local or remote source directory to a relative destination path under snapshot_root.

comment.description: Optional human-readable comment describing this backup entry.

source_dir.description: Source directory to back up. May be remote (e.g., 'user@host:/path/') or local. Trailing slash matters (see rsync docs).

dest_dir.description: Destination path (relative to snapshot_root). Must be unique per entry. No leading slash.

exclude_patterns.description: List of rsync --exclude patterns. Applied to exclude specific files/dirs from all backups.

pre_backup.description: Command to run before each rsnapshot run (e.g., mounting a backup drive).

post_backup.description: Command to run after each rsnapshot run (e.g., unmounting a backup drive).

lockfile.description: Path to lockfile used to prevent concurrent rsnapshot processes.

one_file_system.description: If true, rsync will not cross filesystem boundaries (adds --one-file-system).

preserve_hardlinks.description: Preserve hard links between snapshot levels (rsync --hard-links). Required for efficient deduplication.

preserve_symlinks.description: Preserve symlinks (rsync --symlink). Set to false to convert symlinks to real files.
